newsitem.title: USA: PLM said receives offer from Equis.
newsitem.headline: PLM said receives offer from Equis.

text.p: PLM International Inc Tuesday said it received an offer from Boston-based limited partnership Equis Financial Group to acquire all of its outstanding shares of common stock $5 per share cash.

In a press release, the company said it would consider the offer and also had asked its legal counsel to review with the appropriate authorities recent irregularities and unusual trading activity in PLM International's common stock.
PLM International is an equipment leasing and management company providing services to transportation, industrial, and commercial companies.
